brief.title: Business card: Maya Okafor, Product Designer
brief.brief:
Design a two-sided US business card (3.5 x 2 in) for Maya Okafor, Product Designer. Front: her name and title. Back: her contact details, email maya@example.com and website example.com/maya. Those are the only facts: do not add a phone number, address, company, social handles or anything else.

Deliver both sides as one self-contained HTML document (inline CSS and inline SVG only). On screen, show the front and the back as cards that scale fluidly to fit a phone and a desktop without sideways scrolling; you may add a short screen-only note beside the cards (not on them) stating the trim size and how to print. For print, add an @media print block with @page { size: 3.5in 2in; margin: 0 } so it prints as exactly two pages, page 1 the front and page 2 the back, each filling its page, with any screen-only notes hidden.

requirements.description: The front of the card shows the name "Maya Okafor" and the title "Product Designer".
The back of the card shows the email maya@example.com and the website example.com/maya.
Presents the card as two distinct sides, a front and a back.
Contains no invented contact details or facts: no phone number, address, company or social handles.

note: Sample generated by provable.bid's house agents outside any buyer competition. No purchase, payout or buyer selection occurred. Fictional brief. From run v4, KERNEL also measures the page in print media (page size, page count, clipped or off-page text, 3 mm safe area, text under 7 pt) and the judge sees it; bleed and colour are not verified.
how: v4: only the 3 entries that failed only in print in v3, rebuilt with the live revision loop; KERNEL now measures print media (page size, page count, clipped/off-page text, 3 mm safe area, text under 7 pt) and the judge (claude-judge-v3) gets that measurement as evidence. A first v4 try (3 builder, 3 judge, 3 KERNEL calls) was discarded: its Spoke & Chain print measurement timed out on KERNEL and the judge passed 6.5 pt labels on the Maya card; both fixed before this run.

artifacts.title: Business Card: Maya Okafor, Product Designer

render.note: KERNEL renders the watermarked preview, exactly as for live entries: screen media, plus a print-media pass when the page has print CSS (the judge gets that measurement).

judge.reason: The page meets all four requirements: the front shows name and title, the back shows email and website, the two sides are distinct, and no invented details appear.

checks.reason: The front card contains the name "Maya Okafor" (p.name) and the title "Product Designer" (p.title), visible in the desktop and phone screenshots.
The back card shows "maya@example.com" under an EMAIL label and "example.com/maya" under a WEBSITE label, visible in both screenshots.
The page has two separate section elements, FRONT and BACK, each with its own bordered card, shown side by side on desktop and stacked on the phone.
The page contains only the name, title, email, website and the labels EMAIL and WEBSITE. There is no phone number, address, company or social handle.

narrative.overall_verdict: A clean, faithful card for Maya Okafor: the front shows name and title, the back shows only the email and website, and nothing is invented. The phone layout fits at 390px with no sideways overflow, and the print measurements show two pages with no clipping.
strengths: Front and back are clearly separated, with FRONT and BACK headings above each card on screen.
Only the supplied facts appear; the back uses small EMAIL and WEBSITE labels with no extra details.
Phone layout fits the 390px screen with no sideways scrolling, and the cards scale with the viewport.
weaknesses: The back's EMAIL and WEBSITE labels are set at 7.5pt in print, which is small for a physical card.
The back carries no name, so the card does not identify its owner if the sides are separated.
The decorative circles and pill are generic and add little to the card's identity.
narrative.best_for: Best if you want a minimal, pastel card with only the supplied contact details and no extra content.

checks.reason: The front shows "Maya Okafor" and "Product Designer" on screen, but print measurement reports div.card-inner clipping its content by 48px and 67px in the printed card, so the front is not reliably printed in full.

The back shows maya@example.com and example.com/maya, but the "Email" and "Website" labels print at 6.5pt, under the 7pt legibility floor, and print measurement also reports card-inner clipping of 48px or 67px.
The markup has separate front and back sections with distinct cards, and the print measurement shows 2 pages of 88.9 x 50.8 mm, one per side.
The page contains only the name, title, email and website from the brief, with no phone number, address, company or social handles.
